name: ClickSyncr for GetResponse
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for GetResponse connects Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator to GetResponse. Each configured form sends its submissions to the GetResponse list you choose, with no code required.

GetResponse

Connected forms send their submissions to GetResponse. “GetResponse” is a trademark of its respective owner. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by GetResponse. Read more in the GetResponse privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “ClickSyncr for GetResponse”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Edit a form in any supported builder and open its ClickSyncr GetResponse settings.
  4. Paste your GetResponse API key, choose a list, and map your fields (email is required). Save.
